motions.item_title: A Resolution of Eagle Mountain City, Utah, Protesting the Red Cedar Corporation Annexation Petition Filed with the Town of Cedar Fort on July 27, 2026.
motions.motion: Councilmember Wood moved to approve a Resolution of Eagle Mountain City, Utah, Protesting the Red Cedar Corporation Annexation Petition Filed with the Town of Cedar Fort on July 27, 2026 . Councilmember Wright seconded the motion.
motions.headline: City protests Cedar Fort annexation of Red Cedar land
motions.summary: The council formally objected to Red Cedar Corporation's petition, filed July 27, to annex its land into the neighboring Town of Cedar Fort.
motions.impact: No street, bill or service changes because of this. The council is staking Eagle Mountain's claim in a boundary fight with a neighboring town, and where that land ends up gets settled later, not by this vote.
